summary: Iteration 134 — Marketing portal master-data linkage. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed for the four validation surfaces called out in the review (dewi_kreator_requests._resolve_links, marketing_kol_ops POST /kol/catalog + /kol/sessions, marketing_account_health POST /manual-snapshot). Verified: (1) POST /api/dewi/kreator-requests rejects missing kreator_id (400 'Pilih kreator dari Master KOL & Kreator'), missing account_id (400), creator not assigned to the toko (400), warna outside rahaza_colors (400 'Warna tidak ada di master'), and bad model_id (400); (2) valid payload: kreator_name/kreator_handle/account_name/platform are filled from masters (server-side, typed values in body are ignored) and sample_colors are normalized to master casing (e.g. 'hitam' → 'HITAM'); (3) POST /api/marketing/kol/catalog with fake fg_product_id → 400 'harus dipilih dari Master FG', with valid fg_product_id server overwrites product_name/sku/category from rahaza_materials (typed values ignored); (4) POST /api/marketing/kol/sessions rejects creator not assigned to account (400) and stores platform from account regardless of what client sends; (5) POST /api/marketing/health/manual-snapshot rejects when account_id missing/fake (400 'Pilih toko dari Kelola Akun') and overrides typed platform/account_name with values from marketing_platform_accounts. Frontend spot-check on Marketing → KOL & Kreator → Permintaan Kreator → 'Request Baru' modal: all data-testid picker elements render (kreator-req-add-btn, kreator-form-account, kreator-form-creator, kreator-form-model, kreator-form-colors, kreator-form-sizes). Kreator picker shows 'Pilih toko dulu' placeholder before toko is chosen; after toko pick platform+kode are read-only and 15+ Master Warna chips (HITAM/PUTIH/BUTTER YELLOW/MAHOGANY/BURGUNDY/CARAMEL/HIJAU BOTOL/DUSTY/MOCA/DENIM/GREY/MAGENTA…) + Master Ukuran chips (ALL SIZE/S/M/L/XL/XXL/Standar/Jumbo) render from rahaza_colors/rahaza_sizes. No free-text creator/handle/colors/sizes inputs anywhere in the form. Seed restored via seed_golive_restore.sh --force after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: dewi_kreator_requests.py:_resolve_links — the 'assigned' array is checked with `if assigned and aid not in assigned` so a creator whose assigned_account_ids is empty is NOT enforced (any toko passes). That is consistent with kol/sessions logic but arguably should reject creators with no assignments outright (or require assignment on the creator master). Consider making 'has at least one assigned toko' a required invariant at the Master KOL level.

marketing_kol_ops.py:_apply_fg overwrites product_name/sku/category unconditionally — good — but does not validate uniqueness on (account_id, fg_product_id) so the same FG can be added twice with different accounts is fine, however if the same FG has already been added to the same account under a slightly different (stale) SKU, the SKU-uniqueness check will collide on the NEW canonical code. Consider also checking (account_id, fg_product_id) uniqueness for a nicer error message than 'SKU sudah ada'.

marketing_account_health_routes.py:manual-snapshot — payload.platform / account_name are still declared on the Pydantic model as writable. They are overwritten from the account master (good), but exposing them in the OpenAPI schema as inputs is misleading; mark them as Optional[str] read-only or drop from the request model to prevent client confusion.

dewi_kreator_requests.py:update_request — the exclusion list for `upd` prevents rewriting derived fields (kreator_name/account_name/platform/model_code…) but forgets 'kreator_code'. If client sends a stale kreator_code with a new kreator_id, _resolve_links overwrites it correctly, but the same explicit-exclusion pattern should list it for consistency and defense-in-depth.

rca of the issue: N/A — feature validation, not a bug repro. The prior state accepted free-text kreator_name/colors/sizes/product_name; the fix (main agent) centralized validation in dewi_kreator_requests._resolve_links and marketing_kol_ops._fg_master / _apply_fg + already-existing assigned_account_ids check in create_session, and added the master-account requirement to marketing_account_health_routes.create_manual_snapshot. All four surfaces now reject free-text and override typed identity fields with authoritative master values.
